newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm files suit vs Ericsson.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm files suit vs Ericsson.

text.p: Qualcomm Inc said on Friday it filed against Ericsson Inc alleging patent infringement, based on public statements by Ericsson that it planned to sell code division multiple access handsets in the United States within a matter of months.

The lawsuit, filed in federal court in San Diego, charged Ericsson with allegedly infringing seven Qualcomm patents covering features of handsets which met the U.S. code division multiple access cellular telecommunications standard or the standard for a new PCS wireless services, it said.
Ericsson Inc is a U.S. unit of Swedish telecoms group Ericsson. Ericsson declined to comment on the suit until it had seen more details.
Qualcomm said it held patents essential to practice both standards and to the manufacture and sale of handsets for use in systems compatible with the standards.

An Ericsson company was a licensee under Qualcomm's Patents for the manufacture of handsets for use in the Globalstar satellite communications system, but Qualcomm said it had not granted Ericsson a license for cellular, PCS or other terrestrial applications.
